newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria's weekly forex demand falls to $39.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria's weekly forex demand falls to $39.7 mln.

text.p: Nigeria's Central Bank said on Friday it sold $39.731 million at a rate of 85 naira to the dollar at its weekly auction this week.
Last week the bank sold $47.439 million at the same rate.

Dealers said demand had fallen steadily since the naira was devalued by 5.88 percent last month. The central bank also asked banks to provide details of forex end-users in order to stem capital flight and speculative buying.
